scripts.build: pnpm --filter ofdh5 build && pnpm --filter ofdh5-vue2 build
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:vue2 && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.publish: pnpm --filter ofdh5 publish --no-git-checks --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter ofdh5-vue2 publish --no-git-checks --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
